name: Lern Kalender: School Planner
subtitle: School at a glance for parents
promotionalText: New: grade goals per subject, exam countdown for parents and a weekly report by push. Buy once, no subscription.
description:
See how your child studies – without asking.

Lern Kalender brings timetable, homework, study time and grades together in one place – for students to stay on track, for parents to stay in the loop. Buy once, no subscriptions, no ads.

FOR PARENTS
• Parent dashboard: study time today and this week, grades, streak, weekly overview – for every child
• Exam countdown: "Math in 3 days – 4 hours studied" or "not started yet". You know before it's too late.
• Push to the parent's phone: "Math – 45 min studied", new grades, reminder 3 days before an exam, weekly report on Sunday
• Set study goals (daily/weekly) and send motivation messages
• Multiple children, linked with a 6-digit code, secured via iCloud

FOR STUDENTS
• Timetable & homework automatically from WebUntis (compatible with WebUntis) – including substitutions, cancellations and push on changes
• Study timer with Live Activity on the lock screen and background sound (rain, brown noise)
• Study streak with streak freezes – motivation without pressure
• Grades with goals: set a target average, the app tells you which grade you need next
• Subjects per school year, written/oral averages, subject comparison
• Calendar with exams, study days and school holidays for all German states
• Statistics by week, month, year – and a school-year recap in story format
• Home screen widget: today's study time, your streak and the next exam at a glance
• Live Activity: the running study timer on your lock screen

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Data stays on your device and in your iCloud
• Family feature only via your secret code – nobody else sees the data

Lern Kalender is built by a student for students and parents. Questions or ideas? Write to us – we answer ourselves.

Lern Kalender is an independent product and is not affiliated with Untis GmbH. WebUntis is a trademark of Untis GmbH.
whatsNew:

reviewNotes: The family feature needs two devices. To test: start the app in student mode, go to Settings → Family and generate a code; on a second device choose parent mode and enter the code. WebUntis sync is optional and needs school credentials – the app works fully without it.
